defmodule DistCache.Client do
  @moduledoc """
  Distributed cache client with async operations and NIF-based serialization.
  Uses a custom binary protocol for efficient network communication.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @default_timeout 5_000
  @max_payload_size 1_048_576
  @header_magic <<0xCA, 0xFE, 0xBA, 0xBE>>

  defstruct [:socket, :pending, :buffer, :node_id, :serializer_ref]

  # --- Public API ---

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: opts[:name] || __MODULE__)
  end

  def async_get(server, key, opts \\ []) do
    timeout = Keyword.get(opts, :timeout, @default_timeout)
    task = Task.async(fn ->
      GenServer.call(server, {:get, key}, timeout)
    end)
    {:ok, task}
  end

  def async_put(server, key, value, opts \\ []) do
    timeout = Keyword.get(opts, :timeout, @default_timeout)
    task = Task.async(fn ->
      GenServer.call(server, {:put, key, value}, timeout)
    end)
    {:ok, task}
  end

  def await_result(task, timeout \\ @default_timeout) do
    Task.await(task, timeout)
  end

  # --- GenServer Callbacks ---

  @impl true
  def init(opts) do
    host = Keyword.fetch!(opts, :host)
    port = Keyword.fetch!(opts, :port)
    node_id = Keyword.get(opts, :node_id, generate_node_id())

    case :gen_tcp.connect(to_charlist(host), port, [
      :binary, active: :once, packet: :raw, nodelay: true
    ]) do
      {:ok, socket} ->
        state = %__MODULE__{
          socket: socket,
          pending: %{},
          buffer: <<>>,
          node_id: node_id,
          serializer_ref: init_serializer(node_id)
        }
        {:ok, state}
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:stop, reason}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:get, key}, from, state) do
    req_id = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(8)
    payload = encode_request(:get, req_id, key, nil, state)
    case :gen_tcp.send(state.socket, payload) do
      :ok ->
        pending = Map.put(state.pending, req_id, from)
        {:noreply, %{state | pending: pending}}
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:reply, {:error, reason}, state}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:put, key, value}, from, state) do
    req_id = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(8)
    payload = encode_request(:put, req_id, key, value, state)
    case :gen_tcp.send(state.socket, payload) do
      :ok ->
        pending = Map.put(state.pending, req_id, from)
        {:noreply, %{state | pending: pending}}
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:reply, {:error, reason}, state}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info({:tcp, socket, data}, %{socket: socket} = state) do
    :inet.setopts(socket, active: :once)
    new_buffer = state.buffer <> data
    {responses, remaining} = parse_responses(new_buffer, state)
    new_state = dispatch_responses(responses, %{state | buffer: remaining})
    {:noreply, new_state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info({:tcp_closed, socket}, %{socket: socket} = state) do
    Logger.warning("Connection closed for node #{state.node_id}")
    {:stop, :connection_closed, state}
  end

  # --- Protocol Encoding/Decoding ---

  defp encode_request(op, req_id, key, value, state) do
    op_byte = case op do
      :get -> <<0x01>>
      :put -> <<0x02>>
      :delete -> <<0x03>>
    end

    serialized_key = serialize_term(key, state.serializer_ref)
    serialized_value = if value, do: serialize_term(value, state.serializer_ref), else: <<>>

    body = op_byte <> req_id <> <<byte_size(serialized_key)::32>> <>
           serialized_key <> serialized_value

    @header_magic <> <<byte_size(body)::32>> <> body
  end

  defp parse_responses(buffer, state, acc \\ []) do
    case buffer do
      # Reject frames larger than the allowed maximum before allocating/slicing
      # to prevent unbounded memory consumption from a malicious/compromised peer.
      <<0xCA, 0xFE, 0xBA, 0xBE, length::32, _rest::binary>> when length > @max_payload_size ->
        raise "Frame exceeds maximum payload size (#{length} > #{@max_payload_size})"

      <<0xCA, 0xFE, 0xBA, 0xBE, length::32, rest::binary>> when byte_size(rest) >= length ->
        <<frame::binary-size(length), remaining::binary>> = rest
        response = decode_response_frame(frame, state)
        parse_responses(remaining, state, [response | acc])

      _ ->
        {Enum.reverse(acc), buffer}
    end
  end

  defp decode_response_frame(frame, state) do
    <<status::8, req_id::binary-size(8), payload::binary>> = frame
    value = if byte_size(payload) > 0 do
      deserialize_term(payload, state.serializer_ref)
    else
      nil
    end
    {req_id, status, value}
  end

  defp dispatch_responses(responses, state) do
    Enum.reduce(responses, state, fn {req_id, status, value}, acc ->
      case Map.pop(acc.pending, req_id) do
        {nil, _pending} ->
          Logger.warning("Received response for unknown request")
          acc
        {from, new_pending} ->
          reply = case status do
            0x00 -> {:ok, value}
            0x01 -> {:error, :not_found}
            0x02 -> {:error, :server_error}
            _ -> {:error, :unknown_status}
          end
          GenServer.reply(from, reply)
          %{acc | pending: new_pending}
      end
    end)
  end

  # --- Serialization Layer ---
  # Uses Erlang External Term Format with controlled deserialization

  defp init_serializer(node_id) do
    # Initialize serializer context with node identity for signing
    :crypto.hash(:sha256, node_id)
  end

  defp serialize_term(term, _ref) do
    :erlang.term_to_binary(term, [:compressed, minor_version: 2])
  end

  defp deserialize_term(binary, ref) do
    # Validate HMAC before deserialization to prevent tampering
    case validate_and_extract(binary, ref) do
      {:ok, payload} ->
        :erlang.binary_to_term(payload, [:safe])
      :error ->
        raise "Integrity check failed"
    end
  end

  defp validate_and_extract(binary, ref) do
    # Protocol: last 32 bytes are HMAC-SHA256 of the payload
    payload_size = byte_size(binary) - 32
    if payload_size > 0 do
      <<payload::binary-size(payload_size), received_mac::binary-size(32)>> = binary
      computed_mac = :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, ref, payload)
      # Timing-safe comparison
      if :crypto.hash_equals(computed_mac, received_mac) do
        {:ok, payload}
      else
        :error
      end
    else
      :error
    end
  end

  # --- Utilities ---

  defp generate_node_id do
    :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
  end
end

defmodule DistCache.Pipeline do
  @moduledoc """
  Batched pipeline operations for the distributed cache.
  """

  def execute(server, operations, opts \\ []) do
    tasks = Enum.map(operations, fn
      {:get, key} ->
        {:ok, task} = DistCache.Client.async_get(server, key, opts)
        task
      {:put, key, value} ->
        {:ok, task} = DistCache.Client.async_put(server, key, value, opts)
        task
    end)

    timeout = Keyword.get(opts, :timeout, 10_000)
    results = Task.await_many(tasks, timeout)
    {:ok, results}
  end
end
